design: Exploratory audit of fixed Phase 13 outputs; no new simulation
primary_slice: rho=0.65, dev_n=5000; all 3 evaluation shifts, 4 methods
interpretation: Negative delta means lower held-out CVaR95 than Dijkstra
uncertainty: Two-stage city/OD bootstrap, percentile 95% CI; only five cities, so intervals may be unstable
testing: Exact two-sided city sign-flip tests; Holm adjustment over four methods within each shift; minimum attainable nonzero two-sided p with 5 cities is 0.0625
dependence: Other rho and sample sizes reuse the same OD pairs; do not treat rows across conditions as independent
caveats: Different network extraction pipelines across cities
Only 5 geographic clusters; inferential power limited
